title: "Share Your Experience"
pagetitle: "Share your experience of 12 Days to Deming"
description: "Tell us how 12 Days to Deming has helped you — a short, optional form, with the choice to be quoted publicly or to stay anonymous."
execute:
  echo: false
---

<div id="share-form-view">

This web edition exists because a course this good deserved to be more than a stack of PDFs. If it's been useful to you, a few sentences from you would help someone else decide it's worth their twelve days.

There are three questions: how you're finding the course, whether I may quote you on this site, and — only if you say yes — what name and role to put to it. You can say yes anonymously, or no entirely; the answer is genuinely fine either way, and nothing is published without you choosing that option explicitly.

If instead you've hit something confusing or broken, you don't need this form at all — the thumbs-down at the foot of any chapter has a box for exactly that, and it goes straight to me.
